rationale: Data engineers at Salesforce-connected companies are a real, named buyer with budget (they already pay Fivetran/Airbyte), and schema drift causing silent warehouse corruption is a genuine, documented production pain. However, building a robust Salesforce CDC schema-drift handler requires deep Salesforce Pub/Sub API integration, event schema registry logic, and warehouse-specific connectors — well beyond a Claude prompt + Stripe link in a week. Operational autonomy is also limited: schema drift incidents often require human investigation to validate correctness, and enterprise data pipeline customers have high support expectations. Fails `buildability_with_ai` (4 vs floor 6) and `operational_autonomy` (4 vs floor 7).
solution_plan: This would be a schema-drift monitoring and auto-remediation layer for Salesforce CDC pipelines. The factory cannot build the actual Salesforce Pub/Sub + schema registry + warehouse connector stack without real engineering — this is beyond Claude + standard tooling for a solo non-technical operator. At validate stage: write a detailed problem + solution post on the Salesforce developer community and data engineering Slack groups (dbt Slack, Locally Optimistic), link to a waitlist page with a pricing signal ($199/mo), and see if 5+ data engineers express intent. If validated, this needs a technical co-founder or contractor.
notes: Fails build_gates: buildability_with_ai=4 (floor 6), operational_autonomy=4 (floor 7). Salesforce Pub/Sub + schema registry integration requires engineering depth not achievable with Claude + standard tooling.
